description: XSUAA Security Descriptor for SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Python MCP Server

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.mcp.read
scopes.description: Read MCP resources, prompts, and inspect server capabilities

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.mcp.execute
scopes.description: Execute MCP tools and trigger outbound SAP BTP Destination calls

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.mcp.admin
scopes.description: Administer MCP server configuration and diagnostics

scopes.name: uaa.user
scopes.description: UAA User token scope required for Approuter & token exchange

attributes.name: CompanyCode
attributes.description: SAP Company Code attribute for row-level authorization

role-templates.name: MCPViewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access to MCP resources and prompts

role-templates.name: MCPUser
role-templates.description: Standard access to invoke MCP tools and read resources

role-templates.name: MCPAdmin
role-templates.description: Full administrative access to the MCP server

role-collections.name: BTP_MCP_User
role-collections.description: SAP BTP MCP Server Standard User Role Collection

role-collections.name: BTP_MCP_Admin
role-collections.description: SAP BTP MCP Server Administrator Role Collection
